articles.author: Delixy Holdings Ltd
articles.headline: Delixy Holdings Limited Signs Non-Binding Letter of Intent for Strategic Transaction Involving Up to 48% Interest in East Kazakhstan Sarybulak Oil Field
articles.summary: Delixy announces a nonbinding LOI to evaluate acquisition or restructuring alternatives involving up to 48% of a Kazakhstan oilfield operating company. The LOI is not a completed acquisition, established control of the field or guaranteed future production.
